narrator.description: calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you dig a hole and bury your bad report card, nobody will ever find it. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the dog digs it right back up. So you dig deeper, way below where the dog can reach.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But rain turns the hole to mud and the card floats up. So you seal it in a metal box.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the fresh dirt looks suspicious. So you plant flowers on top.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the box makes a lump in the lawn. So you roll the ground perfectly flat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, you hid your report card forever.
